item.title: S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and the Nasdaq composite goes negative for the year
item.description: AI stocks have hefty market values and have a much bigger impact on the market's direction. They were responsible for Wall Street's big gains this year and are now behind the big slide for the market.

item.title: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
item.description: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump

item.title: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
item.description: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.
